parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (TPS70933DBVR: 2.2 µF p.3 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 1 µF p.5); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TPS7A0233PDBVR is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.4) vs TPS70933DBVR at 30 V rec. (32 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS70933DBVR supplies up to 150 mA (p.5) compared to TPS7A0233PDBVR at 200 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (TPS70933DBVR: 960 mV p.5 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 270 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS7A0233PDBVR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6.5 V, p.4) than TPS70933DBVR (32 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6.5 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TPS70933DBVR requires Vin,min >= 2.7 V (p.4) vs 1.5 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: TPS70933DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS7A0233PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x; Vin,max rating drops >=20%; Iout,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 54.1 °C on TPS70933DBVR (θJA 212.1 °C/W) vs 46.4 °C on TPS7A0233PDBVR (θJA 181.9 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 52x ratio (1.3 µA (p.5) vs 0.025 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS70933DBVR "CRITICAL EN Pin Destruction Trap — 6.5 V Zener Clamp & 7 V Abs Max" (p.4) and TPS7A0233PDBVR "Strict 22 uF Maximum Output Capacitance Limit for Loop Stability" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TPS70933DBVR when input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 30 V); choose TPS7A0233PDBVR when load current exceeds 150 mA (up to 200 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 0.025 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
